title: It works
text: It works. This works. It cuts eggs, which is what it is supposed to do. However, it is very flimsy. The construction and materials of this are a bit sub-standard. I don't expect this to last very long. I don't recommend this.

product_metadata.title: Royal Feast® Egg Slicer for Hard Boiled Eggs- Heavy Duty Molded Plastic- Stainless Steel Cutting Wires- Dishwasher Safe
features: Heavy Duty Dual Purpose 2 in 1 Function
description: This 2-in-1 dual purpose egg slicer features heavy duty molded plastic construction. Its stainless steel cutting wires make even clean cuts during each use. It is also dishwasher safe, making it the perfect addition to any kitchen.
